label: GrandTour forest road
title: Flooded mud
description: Brown water and muddy ruts replace the dry gravel surface.
preserve: Follow the road boundary, tree trunks, and distant structures.
inspect: Do water edges remain stable as the camera moves? Appearance does not establish water depth or traversability.

label: TartanDrive ruts
title: Flooded mud
description: A grassy track becomes a deeply rutted, water-filled path.
preserve: Compare the track direction and the surrounding terrain.
inspect: Inspect apparent rut depth and ground shape. Mud generation can change more than surface texture.

label: GOOSE forest path
title: Frost at dawn
description: Frost and warm dawn light transform a wooded path.
preserve: Track the path edges and the positions of nearby trees.
inspect: Separate the requested frost and lighting from changes to branches, ground texture, or scene geometry.

label: GrandTour stone passage
title: Dense fog
description: Fog changes visibility through a stone passage and open walkway.
preserve: Follow walls, railings, and people as they enter and leave the frame.
inspect: Does haze soften distant detail while preserving nearby boundaries and moving people?

label: Blue hour
title: Impala at blue hour
description: A daylight wildlife crossing is restaged at dusk.
preserve: Follow the animal’s body shape, leg markings, gait, and crossing trajectory.
inspect: Compare the lower legs closely. The generated appearance can change even when the crossing remains recognizable.

label: Fog
title: Impala in fog
description: Fog softens the background around a moving impala.
preserve: Track the animal through the complete clip, including its legs and horns.
inspect: Check for altered markings and changing limb shapes. A coherent background cannot establish subject consistency.

label: Flooded mud
title: Impala on flooded terrain
description: The crossing is surrounded by muddy ruts and water.
preserve: Compare the animal’s trajectory and its contact with the road.
inspect: Inspect changes to the road’s curve and the animal’s lower legs, alongside the requested mud.

label: Golden hour
title: Winter road at golden hour
description: Low sunlight changes the color and contrast of a snowy forest road.
preserve: Follow the car, camera path, road boundaries, and tree line.
inspect: Look for newly visible road markings. Details hidden by the source snow cannot be verified from that source alone.

label: Night rain
title: Winter road in night rain
description: The snowy road is restaged with darkness, wet surfaces, and light reflections.
preserve: Track the car and road alignment throughout the lighting change.
inspect: Inspect light-source consistency, reflections, and changes to vehicle count or shape.

label: Overhead fog
title: Winter road in fog
description: An overhead winter scene becomes a green forest road with haze.
preserve: Compare the vehicle trajectory and the shape of the road corridor.
inspect: The appearance change extends beyond visibility. Decide whether the loss of snow satisfies the intended request.
